author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before had a small flame floating over a single bone-shaped log bar, unlike the reference's big flame on crossed logs; redrawn with a large Lucide-style flame (round body, tall tongue, side tongue behind a notch) sitting on an X of two crossed logs, beside the bare grain stalk with two V branch pairs.
omissions: Branches drawn straight rather than slightly curved; stalk trimmed to the canvas.
